notes.title: Small Update: Improve Oil Behavior and Clarify Achievement Description
notes.content:
Dear Guests,
We sincerely appreciate the support and patronage of our valued customers who have visited and played our game on Steam. We are grateful for the numerous Steam reviews we have received.

Based on your feedback, we are diligently working on further development to create an even more immersive oil-collecting experience. In this update, we have addressed two points below that received a significant amount of feedback:

[list]
[*]The behavior of oil droplets has been improved.
[*]Achievements have been localized in Japanese, with additional descriptive text.
[/list]

Thank you for your patronage of Penguin Gamers' ramen!
